name: Tamar
summary: The widow of Judah's son Er, left waiting when Judah did not give her to his son Shelah. She bore Judah twin sons, and he admitted she was more righteous than he.

key_moments.title: Loses Two Husbands
key_moments.description: Tamar married Judah's son Er, who was wicked, and the LORD put him to death; his brother Onan died too. Judah sent her to live as a widow at her father's home until Shelah grew up.

key_moments.title: Disguises Herself by the Road
key_moments.description: Seeing that Shelah was grown but not given to her, Tamar veiled her face and sat by the road to Timnath. Judah thought she was a harlot, lay with her, and left his signet, bracelets and staff as a pledge.

key_moments.title: Saved by Judah's Pledge
key_moments.description: When Judah heard she was with child, he ordered her burned, but she sent him his own pledge. Judah admitted she was more righteous than he, and she gave birth to twins, Pharez and Zarah.
